notes.title: Massive update
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone! 

This is 0-Game Studios and we are proud to present the full demo version. Now it includes a fully finished Part 1, this part of the game takes place inside an apartment building in the middle of Intown, you are a resident of this house - Henry, who one day discovers that you can no longer leave the house, and every day a mysterious mold takes over more areas of the house.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843699/514535f3e94fa8f46b705a9c655f51cc5ac26439.png"][/img][/p][p]Fight back against this mold! Each of the 4 neighbors will offer an option to fight the mold, choose whose approach suits you best and be prepared to face the consequences. The game has 6 endings, one for each neighbor, one for your cat Abis and one is the worst.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843699/792200b16b6976925d513be0a7dc78369cae153f.png"][/img][/p][p]Replay the game, opening new endings through the choice of levels in the menu.[/p][p]See you in 2026, during the end of the world, do not miss it by adding the game to your wishlist![/p]

notes.title: Added a small portion of the next chapter of stories.
notes.content:
Hello!

Added Part 1 Demo is a short prologue to the first part of a large-scale horror-almanac Intown Nightmares, the main developer is taken away to the army and this game will be a kind of farewell letter for a year, but don't worry, he will definitely come back and the game will be good, we will finish this story and the whole game too, please wait.

notes.title: Release of demo version
notes.content: 0-Game Studios has released a demo version of the horror almanac Intown Nightmares! Maria accepts a job in the woods where she is to collect never-before-seen mushrooms, but strange dreams, moving objects and time distortion begin to haunt Maria. This demo is just the beginning of a larger story unfolding in the dystopian city of Intown. Don't miss the opportunity to plunge into the world of nightmares come true!
